subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should settings.retry.provider.maxRetries intentionally become a budget for repeating complete primary-to-fallback reply cycles after embedded prompt-lock retries are disabled, or must configured users retain request-scoped provider retry semantics?
rationale: The session-lock safety invariant requires no SDK retry in the released-lock window, but the branch’s replacement changes an existing setting’s scope and can affect model selection, attempts, latency, and provider usage. That compatibility contract cannot be inferred safely from code alone.

options.title: Preserve configured retry scope
options.body: Keep the released-lock SDK pin at zero but implement an approved retry owner that preserves configured per-provider attempt semantics, with focused fallback-order and attempt-count tests.

options.title: Adopt full-cycle retries
options.body: Accept the new whole primary-to-fallback-cycle interpretation, document the upgrade behavior, and add proof for configured single-model and multi-fallback installations.

options.title: Narrow to unconfigured recovery
options.body: Retain only the existing one-shot outer recovery for unconfigured users and defer configurable retry relocation to a separately approved design.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured retry scope
recommendation.body: Keep the released-lock SDK pin at zero but implement an approved retry owner that preserves configured per-provider attempt semantics, with focused fallback-order and attempt-count tests.
